_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of four Microsoft Graph Learn pages, as their source in microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib: 'Update tenantAppManagementPolicy', 'Create appManagementPolicy' and 'Assign appliesTo' (the v1.0 HTTP samples for the tenant default app management policy and app-specific policies) and 'Add a certificate to an app by using Microsoft Graph' (the PATCH of keyCredentials that adds a certificate, with and without keeping the existing one). The samples exist only inside these pages. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn samples: Microsoft Graph app management policies (v1.0) and adding a certificate to an app
commit_date: 2026-10-31 (00:42 UTC; October 30 in US time zones)
license: Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Documentation: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (LICENSE). Both copied from the repository root.
not_copied: The SDK snippet include files the pages reference (includes/snippets/*): generated per language from the HTTP samples, which are inline in the pages and are what the tests run.

The beta versions of these pages, the Get, List and List appliesTo pages, the resource pages and the application addKey and removeKey pages, which the chapter cites; everything else in microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib.
